rationale.conceptual: The method consists of plugging numbers into predetermined formulas (Eqs. 2–5) with all constants and inputs supplied. There is no theoretical derivation or interpretation required; it is a textbook application of arithmetic.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is a single script using only numpy, writing one CSV. No multi-step orchestration, no external data fetching, and no complex environment setup.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires implementing a set of simple empirical equations with explicitly given constants and input values, performing basic arithmetic and square roots. No domain knowledge or algorithmic design is needed; the paper provides everything. Execution is a single short script producing one CSV file.

compute_estimate.reasoning: All inputs are hardcoded constants; the computation is trivial arithmetic with no large datasets or model training. Resource usage is negligible.
